placeholder: Message MyAI… (/image to generate a picture)
pdfNoText: This PDF has no extractable text (scanned?).
pdfTooLarge: PDF is too large (max 30 MB / 2000 chunks).
shortcutHint: e.g. Ctrl+Shift+Space. Alt+Space is reserved by Windows.
shortcutError: Could not register this shortcut (maybe used by another app).
emptyHint: Ask anything, attach a PDF, enable web search, or type /image followed by a description.
setupSubtitle: One-time setup: connect your free Google Gemini key
setupStep2: Sign in with your Google account and click “Create API key”.
setupStep3: Copy the key and paste it below.
keyPrivacy: Your key is stored encrypted in Windows Credential Manager on this PC and is only sent to Google.
setupFromMain: Open the main MyAI window to finish setup.
confirmRemoveKey: Remove the saved API key? You will be asked to enter a key again.
confirmDeleteAll: Delete all conversations, PDFs and images saved on this PC?
errKey: The API key is invalid or not allowed. Check it in Settings → Change key.
errQuota: Google's free limit was reached. Wait a minute (or until tomorrow) and try again.
errServer: Google's servers are busy. Please try again.
errNetwork: No internet connection, or Google could not be reached.
errNoImageModel: Image generation isn't available for this API key.
errImageBlocked: No image was returned (the description may have been blocked).
